From: James Sullivan <j.sullivan@novaresearch.com>

Date: 2028-05-27T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual action plan and evidence ask for onramp

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for the product demo last week. Procurement asked me to pull together a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align legal, security, and purchasing teams on the path to signature. High level asks from our side:

- We need your SOC 2 (most recent) and a short summary of your data retention and deletion policy.
- A draft DPA (or confirmation you accept our standard DPA) and any typical redline we should expect.
- Proposed sequencing: does Redwood prefer MSA + DPA executed concurrently or MSA first / order form after?
- A target close window — procurement is aiming for week of 6/6 if possible.

I attached our MAP template (Novaresearch_MPA_template.xlsx) with the items procurement typically tracks. Can your team populate and return a draft? Also loop in legal folks on your side so we can reduce back-and-forth.

Thanks —
James Sullivan
Senior Procurement Lead
Novaresearch

Hi James —

Appreciate the clear list. I pulled together an initial MAP and a proposed sequencing below and attached our draft MAP that maps owners, deliverables, and target dates. Quick answers up front:

- SOC 2: attached reference to the latest report (SOC2_Report_Q4_2027.pdf) and a one‑page summary included in the MAP.
- DPA: we can start from your DPA or provide our standard; lean is to accept your template and route a Redwood response/limited redline for your review.
- Sequencing recommendation: execute MSA + DPA as a paired package (same day signatures) and then execute the order form once payment/PO is established. That reduces partial obligations and simplifies billing. If procurement needs the order form first for PO creation, we can accommodate a countersigned provisional order form with payment terms to follow.
- Target close: we can align for signature the week of 6/6. To hit that target we need: legal redlines back by 6/1, procurement PO by 6/4, and security evidence review complete by 6/2.

I've cc'd Karthik (sales engineering) for the technical evidence lane and Laura (legal) for contract sequencing. Rishi is on renewal/AM coordination if we need invoice cadence clarified.

Action items in the attached: RW_MPA_draft_20280527.xlsx (stub) — I populated dates and owners for the lanes you listed. Please review and tell me where to shift dates.

Next steps:
- James: confirm the procurement PO window and whether a provisional order form is acceptable if your internal PO timing requires it.
- Anna: any additional compliance items beyond SOC2 we should provision (e.g., penetration test attestation)?
- Laura/Karthik: see inline notes attached for the redline path.

Best,

Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Operations Manager

Hi all —

Looping in with legal's recommended sequencing and a short checklist to minimize iterative rounds:

1) DPA + MSA: we recommend executing the MSA and DPA on the same day. Doing both together reduces ambiguity about data obligations and avoids having to reconcile changes later.
2) Order form: can be signed as a provisional order form earlier for PO creation; final order form to follow after both contracts are executed if pricing or scope changes. Provisional must include term, quantities, and billing contact.
3) Evidence pack: Redwood will provide SOC2_Report_Q4_2027.pdf, a data retention one-pager, and a sysadmin penetration test attestation on request. For faster review, we can provide a redacted SOC2 and an executive summary.
4) Commercial points: payment net 30 is standard for Redwood; we can accept net 45 with a small one-time admin fee (we put the proposed language in the draft response). Uptime credits: we're open to an SLA path but prefer a tiered credit schedule tied to usage and not full contract replacement.

Attachments referenced: "SOC2_Report_Q4_2027.pdf" (evidence pack stub) and a DPA response draft (will upload to the MAP). Laura will take the lead on redlines.

Target dates to hit the 6/6 close window: legal redline tracked back to us by 2028-06-01; procurement PO by 2028-06-04; signatures targeted 2028-06-07 (to give a small buffer). If Novaresearch needs earlier PO lead time, we can move the provisional order form path.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
(attachment: DPA_response_stub.docx)
